description: This Java class defines a REST controller for exporting book data in a project that manages user books. It handles HTTP GET requests at the endpoint '/api/export-books-data' to trigger the export process for the current user's book data.

classes.name: BookExportController
classes.description: The main REST controller class handling book data export requests.

methods.name: exportBooksData
methods.description: Handles GET requests to export the current user's book data.
